ValidationRule.description: Stage gate: Employer and insurer contracts, Closed won and later stages need Amount, Close date and Governance review passed.
ValidationRule.errorConditionFormula: AND(RecordType.DeveloperName = "Employer_insurer_contracts", CASE(StageName, "Qualified", 1, "Discovery", 2, "Proposal", 3, "Governance review", 4, "Pilot", 5, "Contract out", 6, "Closed won", 7, 0) >= 7, OR(ISBLANK(Amount), ISBLANK(CloseDate), NOT(Governance_review_passed__c)))
ValidationRule.errorMessage: Fill in Amount, Close date and Governance review passed before moving to Closed won.
